                    [32m'            };\n'[39m +
                    [32m'            await this.storeClientInfo(clientInfo);\n'[39m +
                    [32m'            try {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                await this.handleAction(ws, message.id, message.args, clientInfo, message.requestId, message.clientUrl);\n'[39m +

                    [32m'            catch (error) {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                ws.send(packMessage({\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                    type: MESSAGE_TYPE.ACTION_ERROR,\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                    id: message.requestId,\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                    error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                }));\n'[39m +

                    [32m'        }\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    async streamResponse(response, ws, messageTypes, streamId) {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        const startMessage = messageTypes.start === MESSAGE_TYPE.ACTION_START\n'[39m +
                    [32m'            ? {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                type: MESSAGE_TYPE.ACTION_START,\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                id: streamId,\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                status: response.status,\n'[39m +

                    [32m'                id: streamId,\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                status: response.status,\n'[39m +
                    [32m'            };\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        ws.send(packMessage(startMessage));\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        const reader = response.body.getReader();\n'[39m +

                    [32m'                const { done, value } = await reader.read();\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                if (done) {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                    const endMessage = messageTypes.end === MESSAGE_TYPE.ACTION_END\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                        ? { type: MESSAGE_TYPE.ACTION_END, id: streamId }\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                        : { type: MESSAGE_TYPE.RSC_END, id: streamId };\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                    ws.send(packMessage(endMessage));\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                    break;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                }\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                const chunkMessage = messageTypes.chunk === MESSAGE_TYPE.ACTION_CHUNK\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                    ? {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                        type: MESSAGE_TYPE.ACTION_CHUNK,\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                        id: streamId,\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                        payload: value,\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                    }\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                    : {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                        type: MESSAGE_TYPE.RSC_CHUNK,\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                        id: streamId,\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                        payload: value,\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                    };\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                ws.send(packMessage(chunkMessage));\n'[39m +
                    [32m'            }\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        }\n'[39m +

                    [32m'            reader.releaseLock();\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        }\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    async handleAction(ws, id, args, clientInfo, requestId, clientUrl) {\n'[39m +

                    [32m'        url.searchParams.set("__rsc", "");\n'[39m +

                    [32m'    async determineSockets({ include = [], exclude = [], } = {}) {\n'[39m +

                    [32m'        const results = [];\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        for (const socket of sockets) {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'            const clientId = socket.deserializeAttachment();\n'[39m +

                    [32m'            }\n'[39m +
                    [32m'            const clientInfo = await this.getClientInfo(clientId);\n'[39m +
                    [32m'            results.push({ socket, clientInfo });\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        }\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        return results;\n'[39m +

                    [32m'        if (sockets.length === 0)\n'[39m +

                    [32m'                url.searchParams.set("__rsc", "true");\n'[39m +

                    [32m'                        "Content-Type": "application/json",\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                        Cookie: clientInfo.cookieHeaders,\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                    },\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                });\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                if (!response.ok) {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                    console.error(`Failed to fetch RSC update: ${response.statusText}`);\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                    return;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                }\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                const rscId = crypto.randomUUID();\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                await this.streamResponse(response, socket, {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                    start: MESSAGE_TYPE.RSC_START,\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                    chunk: MESSAGE_TYPE.RSC_CHUNK,\n'[39m +

                    [32m'            catch (err) {\n'[39m +

                    [32m'            }\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        }));\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    }\n'[39m +
